summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification of Laravel admin panel at /dashboard. All 27 assertions passed: root -> /dashboard redirect (200), presence of every requested data-testid (sidebar, nav-dashboard, topbar, breadcrumb, empty-state, empty-state-title, user-menu-btn, theme-toggle, sidebar-toggle, search-input), theme toggle flips html.dark class and persists via localStorage ap-theme after reload, sidebar collapses 208px -> 56px and persists via ap-sidebar, user dropdown opens/shows Profil/Pengaturan/Keluar and closes on outside click, Ctrl+K focuses search input, compact UI verified (topbar 48px, buttons/inputs 28px), computed body font-family contains 'Geist', on 390x844 the sidebar is hidden and mobile-menu-btn opens it as an overlay. Only console output is the expected Tailwind CDN production warning; no page errors, no Laravel exception page. Visual review of light/dark screenshots shows good contrast and clean layout.
critical_code_review_comments: Tailwind is loaded from CDN (cdn.tailwindcss.com) which is documented as not-for-production; acceptable for this MVP per user's explicit choice, but worth switching to the Tailwind CLI/PostCSS build before shipping.

toggleSidebar() is invoked on load when ap-sidebar==='collapsed' but the initial DOM already sets data-collapsed='false' and class w-52; the toggle correctly flips these, so behavior is correct. Minor: on very fast reloads there is a brief flash of the expanded sidebar before the inline script runs at end of body. Consider moving the persistence init before body render (similar to the theme init in <head>) to avoid a FOUC on collapsed state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pure Laravel 12 + SQLite app served on port 3000 by php artisan serve (supervisor 'frontend'). No React/FastAPI. Only route is /dashboard. Frontend tests were driven against the public preview URL and all requested acceptance criteria passed. If retesting, reuse the data-testid selectors already present in resources/views/layouts/app.blade.php and resources/views/dashboard.blade.php.
